Truckee Fire Protection District                                                         Board of Directors
                                                                                                                                    Gary R. Botto
                                 Proudly providing service to portions of both Nevada and
                                                                                                                                 Victor R. Hernandez
                                          Placer Counties and the Town of Truckee                                                 Gerald W. Herrick
                                                                                                                                     Erin E. Prado
                                                                                                                                   Paul D. Wilford
                                                                                                                                    Fire Chief
                                                                                                                                Kevin A. McKechnie




The Truckee Fire Protection District will meet in Special Session on Friday, February 20, 2026 in the
Truckee Sanitary District Boardroom located at 12304 Joerger Drive Truckee, California at 2:00 p.m.
The Board may take action on any item appearing on the Agenda unless specifically identified as “Discussion Only” or “Informational Only”. The Board
will not take action on any item not appearing on the Agenda except as permitted by Government Code section 54954.2.

                                                                      AGENDA
1. Call Meeting to Order.
2. Roll Call.
3. Pledge of Allegiance.
4. Clear the Agenda.
5. PUBLIC COMMENTS:
     Members of the public shall be allowed to address the Board of Directors on items not appearing on the agenda that are of interest to the public and are
     within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Board, provided that no action shall be taken unless otherwise authorized by California Government Code
     Section 54954.2. Each speaker will be limited to one (1) appearance and be limited to three (3) minutes, but speaker time may be reduced at the
     discretion of the Board Chair if there are a large number of speakers on any given subject. There shall be no assignment of speaking time from one
     member of the public to another member of the public. The same procedures shall apply to public comment on matters that are on the agenda.


6. CONSENT CALENDAR:
     These items are expected to be routine and non-controversial. The Board will act upon them at one time without discussion. Any Board member, staff
     member or interested party may request that an item be removed from the consent calendar for discussion.
     A. Approval of the January 20, 2026 Regular Board Meeting Minutes.
     B. Approval of the January 8, 2026 Finance Committee Meeting Minutes.
     C. Approval of the January 22, 2026 Finance Committee Meeting Minutes.
     D. Check Register – January 2026.
     E. Fund Balance – January 2026.
     F. Balance Sheets – January 2026.
     G. LAIF Fund Report - January 2026.
     H. TFPD Organizational Chart.
     I. Training Reports – January 2026.                                                                                               Attachment 1
7. STAFF REPORTS:
     A. Chief’s Report.                                                                                                                Attachment 2
     B. Operations Division Chief’s Report.                                                                                            Attachment 3
     C. Fire Marshal’s Report.                                                                                                         Attachment 4
     D. Battalion Chief’s Report.                                                                                                      Attachment 5
     D. Finance Director’s Report.                                                                                                     Attachment 6
     E. Wildfire Prevention Manager’s Report.                                                                                          Attachment 7

8. COMMITTEE REPORTS:
     A. Measure T Citizens’ Oversight Committee (COC).
     B. Fire Protection Funding from Annexation No. 7 Ad Hoc Committee.

9. OLD BUSINESS: No items.

Truckee Fire Protection District
Agenda, Special Board Meeting
February 20, 2026
Page 2 of 2

10. NEW BUSINESS:
      A. Discussion with Possible Action: Resolution 02-2026; A Resolution
         Adjusting Charges and Fees for Providing Ambulance and Emergency
         Medical Services.                                                                     Attachment 8
          1. Consumer Price Index: 2025 in Review Data Chart.                                  Attachment 9
          2. Ambulance Rate Increase Calculation.                                              Attachment 10
      B. Discussion with Possible Action: Operations Manual and Standard Operating Guidelines.
         1. Fireground Operations Guide.                                                       Attachment 11
         2. Multi-Family Standard Operating Guideline.                                         Attachment 12
         3. Residential Fire Standard Operating Guideline.                                     Attachment 13
         4. Commercial Fire Standard Operating Guideline.                                      Attachment 14
      C. Discussion with Possible Action: Revisions and Updates to Policy 1006: Overtime
         Policy.                                                                               Attachment 15
      D. Discussion with Possible Action: MOU with IAFF Local 3800 – Truckee Shop.             Attachment 16
         1. Final MOU TFPD – IAFF Local 3800                                                   Attachment 17
      E. Discussion with Possible Action: Unrepresented Employee Handbook.                     Attachment 18
         1. Unrepresented Employee Handbook.                                                   Attachment 19
      F. Discussion with Possible Action: Fire & Rescue Automatic and Mutual Aid Agreement Attachment 20
         1. Mutual and Automatic Aid Agreement                                                 Attachment 21


11. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS: No items.
12. CLOSED SESSION:
        The Ralph M. Brown Act (Government Code sections 54950-54963) regulates Closed Sessions in Sections 54956.7 through 54957.2. Some, but not
        all, of the permissible items that may be discussed in closed session are threatened or pending litigation, specified employee matters, real property
        negotiations and threats to facilities, public or national security. A public report of any action taken in Closed Sessions is usually required at the
        conclusion of the Closed Session, including a report of the vote or abstention of any member present at that Closed Session.

      A. Conference with Legal Counsel Pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1),
         Existing Litigation, Truckee Fire Protection District v. County of Placer, Sacramento
         County Superior Court Case Number: 25WM000083.
13. RETURN TO OPEN SESSION:
    A. Report from Closed Session.

14. BOARD COMMUNICATIONS
15. ADJOURNMENT
Until further notice Agenda Packets with any attachments are available for public review on the Truckee Fire Protection District website;
www.truckeefire.org. Any documents provided to the Board during the meeting will be available for public review by email request after the meeting to:
monicaskov@truckeefire.org.

Posted and delivered on February 19, 2026
Niki Holoday Administrative Analyst / Clerk of the Board
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the District at (530) 582-7850. Notification
two business days before the meeting should enable the District to make reasonable accommodations to ensure accessibility to the meeting.
